N_enrolled.short_description: Number of students enrolled at the reporting level.
N_enrolled.long_description: Enrollment count reported by the source. Used as the denominator for the coverage and exemption percentages in the same record.

pct_incomplete.long_name: Percent of students with incomplete immunizations
pct_incomplete.short_description: Percentage of assessed school students not up to date and not exempt.
pct_incomplete.long_description: Share of assessed school students who have not completed the required immunizations and do not hold an exemption.
pct_incomplete.statement: In {location}, {value}% of school students had incomplete immunizations.

pct_personal_exempt.long_name: Percent of students with a non-medical (personal-belief) vaccination exemption
pct_personal_exempt.short_description: Percentage of assessed school students with a non-medical exemption (religious, philosophical, or personal-belief) from vaccination requirements.
pct_personal_exempt.long_description: Share of assessed school students holding a non-medical exemption from one or more required vaccines. The exemption categories permitted differ by state law - some allow religious exemptions only, others also allow philosophical or personal-belief exemptions - and this harmonized field aggregates whichever non-medical categories the state reports.
pct_personal_exempt.statement: In {location}, {value}% of school students had a non-medical vaccination exemption.

pct_medical_exempt.long_name: Percent of students with a medical vaccination exemption
pct_medical_exempt.short_description: Percentage of assessed school students with a medical exemption from one or more required vaccines.
pct_medical_exempt.long_description: Share of assessed school students with a physician-certified medical exemption from one or more required vaccines, as reported in the state's annual school immunization survey.
pct_medical_exempt.statement: In {location}, {value}% of school students had a medical vaccination exemption.

pct_religious_exempt.long_name: Percent of students with a religious vaccination exemption
pct_religious_exempt.short_description: Percentage of assessed school students with a religious exemption from one or more required vaccines.
pct_religious_exempt.long_description: Share of assessed school students holding a religious exemption. Reported by states that separate religious exemptions from other non-medical (philosophical or personal-belief) exemptions.
pct_religious_exempt.statement: In {location}, {value}% of school students had a religious vaccination exemption.

pct_mmr.long_name: Percent of students up to date for measles-mumps-rubella (MMR) vaccination
pct_mmr.short_description: Percentage of assessed school students who are up to date for measles-mumps-rubella (MMR) vaccination.
pct_mmr.long_description: Share of assessed school students reported as up to date for measles-mumps-rubella (MMR) vaccination in the state's annual school immunization survey. The antigen-specific series definition, the grade(s) assessed, and whether the figure reflects all enrolled students or only those surveyed vary by state; see the source description.
pct_mmr.statement: In {location}, {value}% of school students were up to date for MMR vaccination.
